title: College Application Roadmap
description: A 12-week path from a researched college list to submitted applications, with essays drafted early and buffers before every deadline.
objective: Submit strong applications to 8–10 well-matched colleges before the January 1 regular decision deadlines.
assumptions: You're a high school senior applying for fall admission
Most schools on your list use the Common App
You can give this about an hour on weekdays
Early action deadlines fall on November 1
priorities: Lock the college list before writing supplements
Protect buffer time before each deadline

title: Foundation
summary: Research schools and build a balanced list.

title: Research colleges that fit your goals
description: Use College Board BigFuture and each school's site to shortlist 20 colleges by major, size, location and cost.

title: Build a balanced college list
description: Narrow to 8–10 schools split across reach, target and likely using admit rates and your GPA/test profile.

title: Identify every deadline and requirement
description: Record each school's deadlines, essay prompts, recommendation and testing policies in one tracker.

title: Create an application tracker
description: Set up a spreadsheet with one row per school and columns for each requirement and its status.

title: Request recommendation letters
description: Ask two teachers and your counselor in person, then send each a one-page brag sheet and the deadlines.

title: Personal statement
summary: Find your story and get a strong draft through two revisions.

title: Brainstorm personal statement topics
description: Free-write for 20 minutes on three Common App prompts and pick the story only you could tell.

title: Write the first full draft
description: Write a complete 650-word draft without editing as you go.

title: Get feedback from two readers
description: Share with your English teacher and one person who knows you well; ask what they remember most.

title: Revise to a final personal statement
description: Apply feedback in two passes: structure first, then line edits; read it aloud before finalizing.

title: Early applications
summary: Finish and submit early action applications with time to spare.

title: Complete the Common App profile
description: Fill in demographics, family, education, test scores and honors so every application starts complete.

title: Write the activities list
description: Describe your top 10 activities in 150 characters each, leading with impact and numbers.

title: Draft early action supplements
description: Write each early school's supplemental essays, reusing research notes from your tracker.

title: Submit early action applications
description: Proofread, pay or request fee waivers, and submit at least three days before November 1.

title: Regular decision
summary: Complete remaining supplements and financial aid forms.

title: Draft regular decision supplements
description: Batch similar prompts (why us, community, intellectual interest) and draft them together.

title: Submit the FAFSA and CSS Profile
description: Gather tax documents with a parent and complete both forms in one sitting.

title: Revise and polish every supplement
description: Cut each essay to its word limit and make sure every school name is correct.

title: Submit regular decision applications
description: Submit everything by December 20 to stay clear of holiday portal slowdowns.

title: Follow-through
summary: Confirm materials and prepare for interviews.

title: Confirm every portal shows complete
description: Log into each applicant portal and resolve any missing documents.

title: Prepare for alumni interviews
description: Practice answers to five common questions and prepare two thoughtful questions per school.

title: Send thank-you notes to recommenders
description: Write short handwritten notes telling them where you applied.

title: College list finalized
description: 8–10 schools chosen and tracked.

title: Personal statement complete
description: Final draft ready to reuse everywhere.

title: Early applications submitted
description: All early action schools submitted.

title: All applications submitted
description: Every regular decision application is in.

title: Essays take longer than planned
mitigation: Start the personal statement in week 3 and keep a buffer week before each deadline.

title: Recommenders submit late
mitigation: Ask early with deadlines in writing and send a polite reminder two weeks out.

title: Burnout during exam season
mitigation: Cap work at an hour on weekdays and front-load the hardest writing.

actions: Spend 45 minutes today listing your must-haves: major, size, region and budget.
Shortlist 20 colleges in BigFuture by Friday.
Ask two teachers for recommendations in person next week.
